# 2 Baruch Chapter 84 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Baruch's Letters

---

**1** "And now therefore, hear me, O Israel; and you who dwell in Babylon, give ear to me."

**2** "For I will tell you the interpretation of all the things which have happened to you from the beginning; for it is not hidden from me."

**3** "That which has happened to you was not unexpected; for it was decreed from the beginning, and it was written in the books of God."

**4** "Now hear me; for after the judgment of your enemies will come deliverance; and after the time of the tribulation will come consolation."

**5** "For the Lord will repay to you everything which is done to you; and he will console those who grieve for Zion."

**6** "And now, O Israel, take note of your steps; and remove not the way of your fathers; for the covenant which was made with your fathers was not made forever."

**7** "But it was renewed for you by the Mighty One; and it will be renewed for your children also."

**8** "And he has promised you that you will not be forsaken in your lifetime, nor will your children be forsaken after you."

**9** "And if you obey the commandments of the law, the Mighty One will protect you; and if you walk in the ways of the Most High, he will not forsake you."

**10** "And now behold, you are in captivity, and you are in a strange land; and I, Baruch, am weeping for you from afar."

**11** "Yet I know that you will return to your land; and there will no more be any such time of misfortune for you; and you will dwell in peace in your holy land, and you will be at rest."

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Paragraph divisions follow the sense units of the source.*
